elements.title: School
elements.description: A primary or secondary school (pupils typically aged 6 to 18).

elements.title: Kindergarten
elements.description: A place for looking after preschool children and (typically) giving early education.

elements.title: College
elements.description: A place for further education, a post-secondary education institution which is not a University

elements.title: University
elements.description: An educational institution designed for instruction, examination, or both, of students in many branches of advanced learning.

elements.title: Library
elements.description: A place to read and/or borrow books.

elements.title: Town Hall
elements.description: A townhall is used as an community administrative center or place of meeting.

elements.title: Courthouse
elements.description: A building which is home to a court of law, which administers justice according to the rule of law.

elements.title: Post Office
elements.description: A place where letters and parcels may be sent or collected.

elements.title: Post Box
elements.description: A box to deposit outgoing postal items.

elements.title: Police Station
elements.description: A police station is a facility where police officers patrol from and that is a first point of contact for civilians.

elements.title: Fire Station
elements.description: A station from which a fire brigade operates.

elements.title: Community Centre
elements.description: A place mostly used for local events, festivities and group activities.

elements.title: Place of Worship
elements.description: A place where religious services are conducted.

elements.title: Bank
elements.description: A financial establishment where customers can, among other services, deposit money and take loans.

elements.title: ATM
elements.description: A device that provides the clients of a financial institution with access to financial transactions.

elements.title: Cemetery
elements.description: A place where people, or sometimes animals are buried that isn't part of a place of worship

elements.title: Grave Yard
elements.description: A place where people (or sometimes animals) are buried, usually close to a place of worship.

image.title: File:Odenbuell Nordstrand St Vinzenz IMGP2940 wp crop.jpg

elements.title: Nursing Home
elements.description: A home for disabled/elderly persons who need permanent care.

elements.title: Driving School
elements.description: A school to learn to drive a motor vehicle.

elements.title: Social Facility
elements.description: A facility that provides social services.

image.title: File:Salvation Army Citadel, Hill Street , Newport - geograph.org.uk - 1585015.jpg

elements.title: Childcare
elements.description: A place where children are looked after which is not a kindergarten.

elements.title: Government Office
elements.description: An office of a (supra)national, regional or local government agency or department

image.title: File:Obama standing in the Oval Office.jpg

elements.title: Conference Centre
elements.description: A conference centre is a large building used to hold a convention

elements.title: Social Centre
elements.description: A centre of fraternities, sororities, professional societies, union halls and other nonprofit organizations.

image.title: File:Governor Hotel, Rotary Club of Portland plaque.JPG

elements.title: Events Venue
elements.description: A place that provides facilities for events such as banquets, weddings etc.

elements.title: Music School
elements.description: Music school, an educational institution specialized in the study, training, and research of music

elements.title: Ranger Station
elements.description: An official park visitor facility with police, visitor information, permit services, etc.

image.title: File:Eagle Ranger Station NRHP 07000713 Clallam County, WA.jpg

elements.title: Prison
elements.description: A prison or jail where people are incarcerated before trial or after conviction

elements.title: Animal Shelter
elements.description: A shelter for animal recovery.

elements.title: Hospital
elements.description: A hospital providing in-patient medical treatment.

elements.title: Clinic
elements.description: A clinic is a medical centre, with more staff than a doctor's office, that does not admit inpatients.

elements.title: Doctor's Office
elements.description: A doctor's office, a place to get medical attention or a check up from a physician.

elements.title: Dentist
elements.description: A dentist practice / surgery.

elements.title: Pharmacy
elements.description: A shop where a pharmacist sells medications.

image.title: File:Boots The Chemist At Gunwharf Quays.jpg

elements.title: Veterinary Clinic
elements.description: A place that deals with the prevention, diagnosis and treatment of disease in animals.

elements.title: Psychotherapy Practice
elements.description: An office of a psychotherapist or clinical psychologist.

elements.title: Defibrillator
elements.description: Defibrillator (AED), an external and portable electronic device that diagnoses and can correct arrhythmia of the heart automatically.

elements.title: Fire Hydrant
elements.description: An active fire protection measure, and a source of water provided in most urban, suburban, and rural areas with municipal water service to enable fire fighters to tap into the municipal water supply to assist in extinguishing a fire.

elements.title: Emergency Phone
elements.description: An emergency telephone is a phone that anyone can use to contact an emergency service.

elements.title: Ambulance Station
elements.description: An ambulance station is a structure or other area set aside for storage of ambulance vehicles, medical equipment, personal protective equipment, and other medical supplies.

elements.title: Mountain Rescue Station
elements.description: A mountain rescue base for a team providing search and rescue services in mountainous environments.

elements.title: Lifeguard Station
elements.description: A place where a lifeguard is on duty

elements.title: Optometrist
elements.description: An optometrist's office

image.title: File:Optometrist adjusts some trial lenses on a Guyanese girl at the Timehri Primary School in Georgetown, Guyana.jpg

elements.title: Fire Extinguisher
elements.description: An active fire protection device used to extinguish or control small fires, often in emergency situations.

elements.title: Emergency Assembly Point
elements.description: A designated (safe) place where people can gather or must report to during an emergency or a fire drill.

elements.title: Emergency Siren
elements.description: A loud noise maker, such as an air raid siren or a tornado siren.

elements.title: Emergency Access Point
elements.description: A sign number which can be used to define your current position in case of an emergency

image.title: File:Anfahrpunkt für Rettungsfahrzeuge HP 108 Alter Lorscher Weg 102 1235.jpg

elements.title: Physiotherapy Practice
elements.description: A facility where a physiotherapist practices physical therapy (kinesiology, exercise, mobilization, etc).

elements.title: Restaurant
elements.description: A restaurant sells full sit-down meals with servers, and may sell alcohol.

elements.title: Fast Food Restaurant
elements.description: A place which offers self-service and take-away food.

image.title: File:SZ Lanting Guoji Mingyuan mall shop Burger King n McDonald's Restaurant May 2024 R12S 01 1.jpg

elements.title: Cafe
elements.description: A generally informal place with sit-down facilities selling beverages and light meals and/or snacks.

elements.title: Bar
elements.description: An establishment in a modern style serving alcoholic drinks, mainly to customers standing around the bar.

image.title: File:HK Central 擺花街 Lyndhurst Terrace sidewalk restuarant bar table n chairs n tender Oct-2011.jpg

elements.title: Pub
elements.description: An establishment in a traditional style that serves alcoholic drinks and food, mainly to customers sitting at the tables.

elements.title: Biergarten
elements.description: An open-air seating area where beer is served.

elements.title: Ice Cream Shop
elements.description: A place that sells ice cream and/or frozen yoghurt over the counter.

elements.title: Bakery
elements.description: A shop selling bread

image.title: File:Bread in shop window at Borough Market.jpg

elements.title: Butcher
elements.description: A shop selling meat or meat products.

elements.title: Greengrocer
elements.description: A shop which sells fruits and vegetables

elements.title: Supermarket
elements.description: A large shop selling groceries, fresh produce, and other goods.

elements.title: Convenience Store
elements.description: A small local shop carrying a variety of everyday products, such as packaged food and hygiene products.

elements.title: Kiosk
elements.description: A small shop on the pavement that sells magazines, tobacco, newspapers, sweets and stamps.

elements.title: Marketplace
elements.description: A marketplace where goods and services are traded daily or weekly.

elements.title: Shopping Mall
elements.description: A group of stores, typically associated with a single building structure.

elements.title: Department Store
elements.description: A large store with multiple clothing and other general merchandise departments.

elements.title: Clothing Store
elements.description: A shop which primarily sells clothing

elements.title: Hardware Store
elements.description: Shop selling primarily metal fasteners and tools, sometimes also other workshop and homeware products.

elements.title: Electronics Store
elements.description: A shop selling consumer electronics such as TVs, radios and fridges.

elements.title: Florist
elements.description: A shop selling bouquets of flowers.

elements.title: Bookshop
elements.description: A store specializing in the sale of books, although it may also sell other printed publications, such as newspapers and magazines.

elements.title: Furniture Store
elements.description: A shop selling furniture.

image.title: File:HK 北角 North Point 和富中心 Provident Centre 和富薈 Provident Square Kuka Home furniture shop Mar-2013.JPG

elements.title: Sports Shop
elements.description: A shop selling sports equipment and clothing.

image.title: File:HK TST East Mody Road Wing On Plaza Shop Kettler Sport Fitness.JPG

elements.title: Toy Shop
elements.description: A shop focussed on selling children's toys.

elements.title: Jewelry Shop
elements.description: A shop that sells rings, necklaces, earrings, watches, etc.

elements.title: Optician
elements.description: A shop that sells, fits, and repairs prescription eyeglasses and contact lenses.

elements.title: Hairdresser
elements.description: A hairdressers or barbers shop, where hair is cut

elements.title: Beauty Shop
elements.description: A non-hairdresser beauty shop, spa, nail salon, etc.

elements.title: Laundry
elements.description: A shop to wash clothes and bedding, generally self-service and unattended.

elements.title: Dry Cleaner
elements.description: A shop or kiosk offering a clothes dry cleaning service.

elements.title: Car Repair Shop
elements.description: A business where cars are repaired.

elements.title: Car Parts Shop
elements.description: A place selling auto parts, auto accessories, motor oil, car chemicals, etc.

elements.title: Car Rental
elements.description: A place from which cars can be rented.

image.title: File:Hertz car rental office Livonia Michigan.JPG

elements.title: Travel Agency
elements.description: A shop selling travel related products and services

image.title: File:Travel agency, The Village, Formby - geograph.org.uk - 1133475.jpg

elements.title: Fuel Station
elements.description: A retail facility for refueling motor vehicles

elements.title: Hotel
elements.description: Hotel – an establishment that provides paid lodging.

elements.title: Motel
elements.description: Short term accommodation, particularly for people travelling by car.

elements.title: Guest House
elements.description: Accommodation smaller than a hotel and typically owner-operated, such as bed&breakfasts etc.

image.title: File:The Crossroads Country Guest House - geograph.org.uk - 88520.jpg

elements.title: Hostel
elements.description: Cheap accommodation with shared bedrooms.

elements.title: Bus Stop
elements.description: A bus stop is a place where public buses stop for passengers.

elements.title: Bus Station
elements.description: A bus station would usually be a terminus where many routes stop / start, and where you can change between routes, etc.

elements.title: Railway Station
elements.description: A railway station.

elements.title: Railway Halt
elements.description: A small station, may not have a platform, trains may only stop on request.

elements.title: Tram Stop
elements.description: A tram stop is a place where a passenger can embark or disembark a tram.

elements.title: Subway Entrance
elements.description: The entrance point of a subway.

elements.title: Taxi Stand
elements.description: A place where taxis wait for passengers. Often near where many people congregate.

image.title: File:Hong Kong Taxi - 1-12-2006 - Shatin Taxi Stand.jpg

elements.title: Parking Area
elements.description: A place for parking cars.

elements.title: Parking Entrance
elements.description: An entrance to an underground or multi storey parking facility.

elements.title: Parking Space
elements.description: A single parking space on a parking lot.

elements.title: Bicycle Parking
elements.description: A parking space designed for bicycles.

elements.title: Motorcycle Parking
elements.description: A place which is designated for parking motorcycles.

elements.title: Car Sharing Station
elements.description: Carsharing station, where you get your booked car, often separate areas on parking places.

elements.title: Bicycle Rental
elements.description: A place, often unattended, where you can pick up and drop off rented bikes.

elements.title: Charging Station
elements.description: A location where battery electric vehicles can be charged.

elements.title: Ferry Terminal
elements.description: A place where people, cars etc. can board and leave a ferry.

elements.title: Airport Terminal
elements.description: An airport passenger building

elements.title: Helipad
elements.description: A landing area or platform designed for helicopters. It might be part of an aerodrome, heliport, hospital, hotel etc.

elements.title: Airstrip
elements.description: A field or area where light aircraft can land and take off from.

image.title: File:Quintin Lodge Airstrip from the Mackinnon Pass 2.jpg

elements.title: Marina
elements.description: A facility for mooring leisure yachts and motor boats.

elements.title: Slipway
elements.description: A slipway: a ramp for launching a boat into water

elements.title: Toll Booth
elements.description: A place where a road usage toll or fee is collected.

elements.title: Weighbridge
elements.description: A large weight scale to weigh vehicles and goods.

image.title: File:Lorry on weighbridge, Douglas, Isle of Man - geograph.org.uk - 352285.jpg

elements.title: Speed Camera
elements.description: A fixed road-side or overhead speed camera.

elements.title: Traffic Signals
elements.description: A traffic signal (or a set of those) for regulating circulation.

elements.title: Stop Sign
elements.description: A point at which a vehicle must come to a complete stop.

elements.title: Pedestrian Crossing
elements.description: The location of a street crossing for pedestrians, cyclists, or equestrians.

elements.title: Street Lamp
elements.description: A single pole with one or more lights to illuminate the street.

elements.title: Milestone
elements.description: Stone or metal marker on the side of a road indicating a reference and an approximation of the distance travelled.

elements.title: Guidepost
elements.description: Used to mark a guidepost/signpost

elements.title: Level Crossing
elements.description: A crossing between a railway and a road.

elements.title: Railway Crossing
elements.description: Marks the spot where pedestrians can cross a railway.

image.title: File:Ridgeway Path pedestrian level crossing, Princes Risborough, Buckinghamshire 02.jpg

elements.title: Railway Platform
elements.description: A railway platform.

elements.title: Quay
elements.description: A man-made structure alongside navigable water used for loading and unloading vessels.

elements.title: Breakwater
elements.description: A man-made structure designed to protect a shore or harbour from the sea and waves.

elements.title: Bicycle Repair Station
elements.description: A public tool for self-repair of bicycles.

elements.title: Rest Area
elements.description: Place where drivers can leave the road to rest, but not refuel.

image.title: File:Parking and picnic area at Rest And Be Thankful - geograph.org.uk - 1657648.jpg

elements.title: Motorway Junction
elements.description: An exit from a motorway or other major road.

elements.title: Pier
elements.description: Raised walkway over water supported by pillars or floating and secured.

elements.title: Motorway
elements.description: High capacity highways designed to safely carry fast motor traffic.

image.title: File:Morgendlicher Berufsverkehr auf der BAB A8 beim Kreuz Stuttgart - panoramio.jpg

elements.title: Trunk Road
elements.description: An important road that is not a motorway.

image.title: File:A477 trunk road from the bridge - geograph.org.uk - 1404312.jpg

elements.title: Primary Road
elements.description: A major highway linking large towns. In cities, a major arterial road.

elements.title: Secondary Road
elements.description: A highway linking large towns. In cities, an arterial road of lesser importance.

elements.title: Tertiary Road
elements.description: A road linking small settlements, or the local centres of a large town or city.

elements.title: Unclassified Road
elements.description: Public access road, non-residential.

elements.title: Residential Road
elements.description: Road in a residential area

elements.title: Living Street
elements.description: Road with very low speed limits and other pedestrian friendly traffic rules.

elements.title: Service Road
elements.description: Provides access to a building, service station, beach, campsite, industrial estate, business park, etc.

elements.title: Track
elements.description: A minor land-access road like a farm or forest track.

elements.title: Footway
elements.description: A path mainly or exclusively for pedestrians.

elements.title: Cycleway
elements.description: For designated cycleways.

image.title: File:Bikeway, Bicycle path - sign C13 marked beginning of bikeway, Poland, Sosnowiec.jpg

elements.title: Path
elements.description: A generic path used by pedestrians, small vehicles, for animal riding or livestock walking. Not designated for use by two-track vehicles. Unless subtagged very broad, non-specific meaning.

elements.title: Steps
elements.description: For flights of steps on footways and paths.

elements.title: Bridleway
elements.description: A way intended for use by equestrians.

elements.title: Pedestrian Street
elements.description: Roads mainly / exclusively for pedestrians

elements.title: Road
elements.description: Road with unknown classification.

elements.title: Road Under Construction
elements.description: A highway (road, track or path) currently under construction.

image.title: File:The T12 link road to Wilmore Road under construction - geograph.org.uk - 4452080.jpg

elements.title: Raceway
elements.description: A racetrack for motorised racing, e.g. cars, motorbikes and karts.

elements.title: Busway
elements.description: A dedicated, separate roadway for buses.

elements.title: Passing Place
elements.description: A passing place on a single track road.

elements.title: Corridor
elements.description: A corridor inside a building

image.title: File:HK TST Star House mall corridor interior shop signs Sept-2012.JPG

elements.title: Elevator
elements.description: An elevator (or lift) is used to travel vertically, providing passenger and freight access between pathways at different floor levels. May be solely vertical (typical case) or inclined.

image.title: File:Elevator on the platform of Ningbo Railway Station.jpg

elements.title: Trailhead
elements.description: A trailhead is a designated or customary place where a trip on a trail begins or ends.

elements.title: Via Ferrata
elements.description: A mountain route equipped with fixed cables, stemples, ladders, and bridges where climber is attached to supporting equipment limiting fall.

elements.title: River
elements.description: The linear flow of a river, in flow direction.

image.title: File:Finlay River emptying into the north end of Williston Lake.jpg

elements.title: River Area
elements.description: The water covered area of a river.

elements.title: Stream
elements.description: A naturally-forming waterway that is too narrow to be classed as a river.

elements.title: Canal
elements.description: An artificial open flow waterway used to carry useful water for transportation, waterpower, or irrigation.

image.title: File:Grand Union Canal Walk by the canal - geograph.org.uk - 3135952.jpg

elements.title: Ditch
elements.description: A small artificial drainage waterway, usually unlined.

elements.title: Drain
elements.description: An artificial free flow waterway used for carrying superfluous water, usually lined with concrete.

image.title: File:Iron Cove Ck looking downstream from John St, Croydon.jpg

elements.title: Dam
elements.description: A barrier built across a river or stream to block and regulate the flow of the river.

elements.title: Weir
elements.description: A barrier built across a river to control water speed and depth. Designed to let water flow over the top all the time or at least in specific conditions.

elements.title: Waterfall
elements.description: A place where water flows over a vertical drop or a series of drops in the course of a stream or river.

elements.title: Spring
elements.description: A place where ground water flows naturally from the ground

elements.title: Lake
elements.description: A natural or semi-natural body of relatively still fresh or salt water which is surrounded by land.

elements.title: Pond
elements.description: A small body of standing water, man-made in most cases

elements.title: Reservoir
elements.description: An artificial lake which may be used to store water. Usually formed by a dam over a natural water course.

elements.title: Water Basin
elements.description: An area of land artificially graded to hold water. Includes also structures typically without water.

elements.title: Wetland
elements.description: A natural area subject to inundation or with waterlogged ground

elements.title: Lagoon
elements.description: A body of shallow sea water or brackish water separated from the sea by a barrier.

elements.title: Oxbow Lake
elements.description: U-shaped body of water formed when a wide meander from the main stem of a river is cut off to create a lake.

elements.title: Beach
elements.description: Landform along a body of water which consists of sand, shingle or other loose material.

elements.title: Bay
elements.description: Named area of water mostly surrounded by land but with level connection to the ocean or a lake.

elements.title: Strait
elements.description: A narrow area of water surrounded by land on two sides and by water on two other sides.

elements.title: Coastline
elements.description: The line between sea and land indicating mean high water (springs): the water lies on the right side of the way.

elements.title: Water Tower
elements.description: Structure with a water tank at an altitude to increase pressure in water network

elements.title: Water Works
elements.description: A facility where water is treated to make it suitable for human consumption.

elements.title: Wastewater Plant
elements.description: A wastewater plant is a facility used to treat wastewater.

elements.title: Water Well
elements.description: A structural facility to access ground water, created by digging or drilling.

elements.title: Lock Gate
elements.description: A gate of a lock used to raise or lower boats.

elements.title: Sluice Gate
elements.description: A gate that can be moved up and down to control the flow of water.

elements.title: Fish Pond
elements.description: Water basin constructed specifically for fish farming or recreational fishing.

image.title: File:Cage system in a fish pond.jpg

elements.title: Boatyard
elements.description: A place for constructing, repairing and storing vessels out of the water.

elements.title: Tidal Channel
elements.description: A natural intertidal waterway in mangroves, salt marshes, and tidal flats with water flow in the direction of the tide.

image.title: File:The mudflats in Turnagain Arm at low tide (IMG 1189a) (3587499039).jpg

elements.title: Wood
elements.description: Tree-covered area (a 'forest' or 'wood')

elements.title: Scrub
elements.description: Uncultivated land covered with shrubs, bushes or stunted trees.

elements.title: Heath
elements.description: A dwarf-shrub habitat, characterised by open, low growing woody vegetation, often dominated by plants of the Ericaceae.

elements.title: Grassland
elements.description: An area where the vegetation is dominated by grasses and other herbaceous (non-woody) plants.

image.title: File:Grassland community of the association Ranunculo-Senecionetum aquatici.jpg

elements.title: Meadow
elements.description: An area of meadow or pasture: land primarily vegetated by grass and other non-woody plants, mainly used for hay or grazing.

elements.title: Farmland
elements.description: Area of farmland used mainly for tillage (annual crops).

elements.title: Orchard
elements.description: Used to mark intentional planting of trees or shrubs maintained for food production

elements.title: Vineyard
elements.description: Used to tag vineyards, a piece of land where grapes are grown.

elements.title: Allotments
elements.description: allotment gardens with multiple land parcels assigned to individuals or families for gardening.

elements.title: Park
elements.description: A park, usually in an urban (municipal) setting, created for recreation and relaxation.

elements.title: Nature Reserve
elements.description: A protected area of importance for wildlife, flora, fauna or features of geological or other special interest.

image.title: File:Black Opal Spring in Biscuit Basin.JPG

elements.title: Protected Area
elements.description: Used to mark boundaries of protected areas including national parks, wilderness, marine protection areas, heritage sites and other, similar areas.

elements.title: Peak
elements.description: The top (summit) of a hill or mountain.

image.title: File:North Suicide Peak. Chugach Mountains, Alaska..jpg

elements.title: Cliff
elements.description: A vertical or almost vertical natural drop in terrain, usually with a bare rock surface. The bottom of the cliff is on the right side of the way.

elements.title: Cave Entrance
elements.description: An entrance to a cave: a natural underground space large enough for a human to enter

elements.title: Rock
elements.description: A notable rock or group of rocks attached to the underlying bedrock

elements.title: Scree
elements.description: Unconsolidated angular stones formed by rockfall and weathering from adjacent rock faces.

image.title: File:Cingles i rosseguera sota el Pla de la Casa, la Serrella.JPG

elements.title: Sand
elements.description: An area covered by sand with no or very little vegetation.

elements.title: Glacier
elements.description: A permanent body of ice formed naturally from snow that is moving under its own weight.

elements.title: Volcano
elements.description: An opening exposed on the earth's surface where volcanic material is emitted.

elements.title: Ridge
elements.description: A mountain landform with a continuous elevated crest or linear hill

image.title: File:Aerial view of a mountain ridgeline.jpg

elements.title: Saddle
elements.description: The lowest point along a ridge or between two mountain tops.

image.title: File:Rabbit Lake and the Suicide Peaks. Chugach State Park, Alaska.jpg

elements.title: Tree
elements.description: A single tree.

elements.title: Tree Row
elements.description: A line of trees.

elements.title: Bare Rock
elements.description: An area with sparse or no vegetation, so that the bedrock becomes visible

elements.title: Reef
elements.description: A feature (rock, sandbar, coral, etc) lying permanently beneath the surface of the water.

elements.title: Shingle
elements.description: An accumulation of rounded rock fragments on a beach or riverbed.

elements.title: Fell
elements.description: Habitat above tree line covered with grass, dwarf shrubs and mosses.

elements.title: Valley
elements.description: A natural depression flanked by ridges or ranges of mountains or hills

elements.title: Residential Area
elements.description: A portion of land predominantly used for residential purposes.

image.title: File:Residential buildings along a road in San Francisco.jpg

elements.title: Industrial Area
elements.description: An area with predominantly workshops, factories or warehouses.

elements.title: Commercial Area
elements.description: A commercial zone, predominantly offices or services.

elements.title: Retail Area
elements.description: An area that encloses predominantly shops.

elements.title: Quarry
elements.description: An area of land used for surface extraction (open-pit mining).

elements.title: Landfill
elements.description: A site for permanent or long term storage of waste materials.

elements.title: Construction Site
elements.description: An area being built on.

elements.title: Railway Land
elements.description: An area of land dedicated to train operation or support, including areas around tracks, rail corridors, yards, sidings, station complexes, and ancillary man-made objects along the tracks.

elements.title: Military Area
elements.description: Area used for military purposes.

elements.title: Power Plant
elements.description: An industrial facility where power (electricity, useful heat, biogas) is produced by individual power generator units.

elements.title: Power Substation
elements.description: A facility which controls the flow of electricity in a power network with transformers, switchgear or compensators.

elements.title: Wind Turbine
elements.description: Wind turbine

elements.title: Solar Generator
elements.description: A generator which produces energy (normally electricity) from the sun.

elements.title: Hydroelectric Generator
elements.description: Specifies that generator is using hydropower as source.

elements.title: Soccer Pitch
elements.description: Association football, more commonly known as football or soccer - a sport played on a large soccer pitch by two teams of 11 players trying to kick the ball into the opponent's goal.

elements.title: Basketball Pitch
elements.description: A sport in which two teams of five players play on a rectangular court to score by throwing a ball into the opponent's basket.

elements.title: Tennis Court
elements.description: A sport played by two or four players using a strung racket and a hollow ball on a rectangular court divided by a low net.

elements.title: Baseball Field
elements.description: A bat-and-ball game played between two teams of nine players on a field (pitch or stadium) each who take turns batting and fielding.

elements.title: American Football Field
elements.description: A sport played by two teams of eleven players on a rectangular field with goalposts at each end.

elements.title: Rugby Union
elements.description: A full-contact ball sport played by two teams of 15 players on a large rectangular pitch with H-shaped goals at both ends.

image.title: File:All Black maul vs Springboks Tri nations 2011-07-30.JPG

elements.title: Cricket Pitch
elements.description: A bat-and-ball sport contested by two teams of eleven players, played on a circular or oval-shaped, grassy field.

elements.title: Volleyball Court
elements.description: A sport played on a court with a solid or compact surface by two teams of 6 players, who hit the ball with their hands over the high net to the opponent's side, where it is not allowed to touch the ground.

elements.title: Handball
elements.description: A sport played on a hard court by two teams of 7 players, who pass a ball with their hands to throw it into the opponent's goal.

image.title: File:POL - ISL (01) - 2010 European Men's Handball Championship.jpg

elements.title: Field Hockey
elements.description: A sport in which two teams of 11 players on a rectangular court use curved sticks to direct a hard ball into the opposing team's goal.

image.title: File:Dutch Women Hockey - Shielding the ball.jpg

elements.title: Swimming Pool
elements.description: A swimming pool (water area only)

elements.title: Sports Centre
elements.description: A sports centre is a distinct facility where sports take place within an enclosed area.

elements.title: Stadium
elements.description: A major sports facility with substantial tiered seating.

elements.title: Running Track
elements.description: A track for running, cycling and other non-motorised racing such as horses, greyhounds.

elements.title: Golf Course
elements.description: A golf course

elements.title: Miniature Golf
elements.description: A place or area where you can play miniature golf.

elements.title: Skate Park
elements.description: An area designated and equipped for skateboarding.

elements.title: Playground
elements.description: A playground: an area designed for children to play.

image.title: File:Children playing on a modern playground.jpg

elements.title: Dog Park
elements.description: A designated area, with or without a fenced boundary, where dog-owners are permitted to exercise their pets unrestrained.

elements.title: Fitness Station
elements.description: An outdoor facility where people can practise typical fitness exercises

image.title: File:Outdoor gym in Parque de Bateria, Torremolinos.JPG

elements.title: Water Park
elements.description: An amusement park with features like water slides, recreational pools (e.g. wave pools) or lazy rivers.

elements.title: Bowling Alley
elements.description: A facility that is equipped to play the game of bowling.

elements.title: Horse Riding Centre
elements.description: A facility where people practise horse riding, usually in their spare time, e.g. a riding centre. For a riding arena use tag:leisure=pitch + tag:sport=equestrian.

elements.title: Disc Golf Course
elements.description: A place to play disc golf.

elements.title: Museum
elements.description: A museum: an institution with exhibitions on scientific, historical, cultural topics

elements.title: Art Gallery
elements.description: An area or building that displays a variety of visual art exhibitions.

elements.title: Tourist Attraction
elements.description: An object of interest for a tourist, or a purpose-built tourist attraction

elements.title: Viewpoint
elements.description: A place worth visiting, often high, with a good view of surrounding countryside or notable buildings.

elements.title: Artwork
elements.description: A public piece of art.

elements.title: Information Point
elements.description: Information for tourists and visitors, including information offices

elements.title: Monument
elements.description: A memorial object, which is especially large, built to remember, show respect to a person or group of people or to commemorate an event.

elements.title: Memorial
elements.description: Small memorials, usually remembering special persons, people who lost their lives in the wars, past events or missing places.

image.title: File:Lowertown celtic cross memorial to fallen canal workers.jpg

elements.title: Castle
elements.description: Used for various kinds of castles, palaces, fortresses, manors, stately homes, kremlins, shiros and other.

image.title: File:Castillo de Montuenga, Montuenga de Soria, Soria, España, 2017-05-23, DD 04.jpg

elements.title: Ruins
elements.description: Remains of historic structures that were once complete, but have fallen into partial or complete disrepair.

elements.title: Archaeological Site
elements.description: A place in which evidence of past activity is preserved.

elements.title: Cinema
elements.description: A movie theater, a place showing movies.

elements.title: Theatre
elements.description: A place where live performances occur, such as plays, musicals and formal concerts.

image.title: File:Royal Opera House - Floral Hall - Bow Street - London - 240404.jpg

elements.title: Arts Centre
elements.description: An arts centre. A venue where a variety of arts are performed or conducted

elements.title: Fort
elements.description: A military fort, a stand-alone defensive structure which differs from a castle in that there is no permanent residence.

elements.title: Zoo
elements.description: A zoological garden, where animals are confined for viewing by the public.

elements.title: Building
elements.description: A building of an unspecified type.

elements.title: House
elements.description: A single dwelling unit built for inhabitation by a single household.

elements.title: Apartment Building
elements.description: A building arranged into individual dwellings, often on separate floors. May also have retail outlets on the ground floor.

elements.title: Shed
elements.description: A small, simple structure used as storage or workshop.

elements.title: Garage
elements.description: Denotes a single-owner private garage

elements.title: Garage Block
elements.description: A block of private garages each with a separate owner.

elements.title: Bridge
elements.description: The outline of a bridge, grouping together all features for that bridge.

elements.title: Tower
elements.description: A tower is a large free-standing structure which is higher than it is wide.

elements.title: Wall
elements.description: A freestanding structure, designed to restrict or prevent movement across a boundary, typically made from solid brick, concrete or rocks, and almost always built so that it is opaque to vision.

elements.title: Fence
elements.description: A freestanding structure designed to restrict or prevent movement across a boundary, generally distinguished from a wall by the lightness of its construction.

elements.title: Bench
elements.description: A place for people to sit, allowing room for one or more people.

elements.title: Waste Basket
elements.description: A single small container for depositing garbage that is easily accessible for pedestrians.

elements.title: Recycling Point
elements.description: A container or centre that accepts waste material for reuse or recycling.

elements.title: Shelter
elements.description: A small structure for protection against bad weather conditions

elements.title: Fountain
elements.description: A fountain that can have cultural, decorational or historical significance or which serves a recreational purpose.

elements.title: Public Clock
elements.description: A publicly visible clock

elements.title: Vending Machine
elements.description: A vending machine sells food, drinks, tickets or other goods automatically.

elements.title: Drinking Water
elements.description: A drinking water source which provides potable water for consumption.

elements.title: Public Toilets
elements.description: Indicates publicly accessible toilets.

elements.title: Barbecue
elements.description: A permanently built place for having a BBQ.

image.title: File:BBQ located in Capital Park in Lyndhurst.jpg

elements.title: Food Court
elements.description: A place with sit-down facilities shared by multiple self-service food vendors.

elements.title: Deli
elements.description: A shop selling delicatessen (fine foods), e.g. cured meat and fish, expensive cheeses, luxury confectionery, etc.

elements.title: Confectionery Shop
elements.description: A shop selling sweets and candies.

elements.title: Cheese Shop
elements.description: A shop mainly selling cheese.

elements.title: Wine Shop
elements.description: Shop selling bottled wine.

image.title: File:Wine retail area - Enoteca Vino Bar.jpg

elements.title: Pastry Shop
elements.description: A shop where sweet bakery products are sold.

elements.title: Recreation Ground
elements.description: An open green space for general recreation, which often includes formal or informal pitches, nets and so on. Often municipally owned, sometimes part of colleges / companies or commercially operated.

image.title: File:Outdoor gym in Parque de Bateria, Torremolinos.JPG

elements.title: Village Green
elements.description: A village green is a distinctive area of grassy public land in a village centre. Not a generic tag for urban greenery.

elements.title: Farmyard
elements.description: Area of land with farm buildings (farmhouse, sheds, stables, barns, etc.).

elements.title: Plant Nursery
elements.description: Represents land that is used solely for plant nurseries, which grow live plants.

elements.title: Flowerbed
elements.description: An area designated for flowers.

elements.title: Greenfield
elements.description: Undeveloped land scheduled to turn into a construction site

elements.title: Ice Rink
elements.description: An artificially created place where you can skate and play bandy or ice hockey.

elements.title: Rehabilitation Centre
elements.description: Medical rehabilitation facility, usually inpatient or residential

elements.title: Cape
elements.description: A piece of elevated land sticking out into the sea or large lake.

elements.title: Dune
elements.description: A hill of sand formed by wind, covered with no or very little vegetation
